insertText.text: Keep your word. Grow your forest.
Team Focus Garden: Salem Mohammed Shamakh (@salemkode) — solo builder
Focus Garden is the 2026 upgrade of Crypto Focus Garden (BLAZE 2025, 3rd place, Chipnet track).

Promise a focus session on Bitcoin Cash: stay, and a tree grows into your wallet as a CashTokens NFT; leave, and it withers.

Try it: focus-app.salemkode.com
(also iPhone and Android builds via focus.salemkode.com)
Works in any browser. Judges need a BCH wallet (Selene or Paytaca) and ~15,000 sats.

Amina has an exam on Monday. She opens her notes and, four minutes later, she is scrolling. Focus timers don't help: nothing happens when she quits, and nobody can see that she kept going.

With Focus Garden she promises 26 minutes. A tree is locked on Bitcoin Cash for exactly that long. If she leaves the app for more than 10 seconds, the tree withers. If she stays, the grown tree is sent to her own wallet, where anyone can verify it. Three sprouts merge into a tree, two trees into a big tree, and her garden shows the focus she actually kept.
The problem is attention, not time management. Apps like Forest proved people pay for this loop; Focus Garden adds ownership and public, unforgeable proof.

A reason to stay: leave for 10 seconds and the tree withers [Tested locally]
Proof you can show: every verified tree is a CashTokens NFT in your own wallet [Tested locally]
Rewards grow with focus: sprout → tree → big tree → house, and small trees merge into bigger ones [Tested locally]
No account, no server: the app talks to Bitcoin Cash directly through public Electrum servers [Done on Mainnet (read-only)]
Block distractions: Screen Time on iPhone, usage access on Android [native apps only]
Social: public profile cards, a leaderboard read from the chain, and tips by name [Done on Mainnet (read-only) · Tested locally]

FocusForest contract (CashScript, P2SH32): plantTree mints a tree NFT and locks it with a relative time lock (BIP68, 512-second steps) for the whole session; mergeTrees combines matured trees; claimTree releases the tree and its deposit to the owner. [Tested locally: 76 contract tests]
FocusDirectory contract: anyone can mint one public profile card (name + optional bio). [Tested locally]
Live on mainnet since 19 Nov 2026: both contracts deployed with their minting batons, 100 creator trees minted at genesis, BCMR metadata so wallets show every tree. [Done on Mainnet — txids in the appendix]
WizardConnect + WalletConnect wallet linking; XO engine (@xo-cash/engine, p2pkh template) runs the native fee wallet. [WizardConnect pairing verified 20 Nov on the mainnet web build with a dedicated test wallet]
Why BCH: sub-cent fees per tree, native tokens with no extra contract, and covenant time locks enforced by every node.
FocusForest + FocusDirectory deployed, 100 creator trees, BCMR

Business [Planned]: free to use; optional premium tree styles and group plans, paid in BCH/pUSD.

A3. What was built during BLAZE
What was built during BLAZE (14–22 Nov 2026) vs before — see SUBMISSION.md.

1 Connect (WizardConnect/WalletConnect; only the address is read). 2 Fund the small fee wallet (on the web its key lives in the browser; hold only a little BCH). 3 Plant with Verify on Bitcoin Cash: the app builds, checks and signs a FocusForest plantTree transaction. 4 Stay; when the CSV lock matures, the app releases the tree to the linked wallet.

The chain verifies time, not attention (pair with app blocking); release waits for median block time, so it can lag the session by an hour or more; on the web the fee wallet key lives in browser storage.
